mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to discount future earnings more heavily, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, increasing the likelihood of earnings downgrades and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 700,000 units in two consecutive months signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods and services, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery, increasing consumer spending and corporate revenue visibility, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressures that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars for two consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
